enrichment.core_claim: Label-free electrophysiological sorting and gene signatures predict whether neural stem cells will become neurons or astrocytes before lineage commitment.
enrichment.ask_question: What role do you think N-glycan remodeling via Mgat3 plays in steering progenitors toward neurons?
enrichment.challenge_question: How does predicting progenitor fate connect to consciousness specifically, rather than to brain development in general?
